body: 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. Because the placement of a part is rarely determined by its own geometry, the task demands reasoning over the entire part set, and existing methods, which rely on pairwise relations or iterative generation and verification, scale poorly to objects with many parts. We present LLM2R, which casts part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only large language model (LLM): a Point-BERT encoder and a Q-Former compress each part into a block of geometric tokens, the blocks of all parts are concatenated, and a causal LLM adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) processes the sequence in one forward pass. Causal attention, however, lets the hidden states of a part observe only the parts that precede it. LLM2R therefore appends a block of learnable summary tokens after the last part: these tokens follow every part, so their states aggregate the whole assembly at a constant token cost, and a part-aware pose head fuses each part's states with them before predicting its rotation and translation. One architecture thus handles semantic and geometric assembly and predicts all poses in a single non-autoregressive pass. LLM2R achieves the highest part accuracy and success rate on all three PartNet categories, the best rotation error, translation error, and part accuracy on PartNeXt, and the lowest translation error and fastest inference on Breaking Bad, where only a fracture-specialized method is more accurate. Its advantage grows with the number of parts: at 100 parts it exceeds GARF by 33.5 points in part accuracy on Breaking Bad and Assembler by 29.1 points on PartNet, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories with more than 16 points higher part accuracy than the strongest of three baselines.
summaryZh: 3D零件装配需要通过预测每个零件的刚性SE(3)变换来重构完整形状，由于涉及全局整体推理，传统方法在处理多零件对象时可扩展性较差。本文提出了LLM2R，将零件装配转化为预训练解码器大模型的序列建模任务。利用Point-BERT和Q-Former将零件压缩为几何token，并附加可学习的总结token，使因果大模型通过单一非自回归前向传递预测所有位姿。实验证明LLM2R在多个数据集上取得了最高的零件准确率、成功率和最低的位姿误差，且随着零件数量增加优势愈发显著。

glossary.explanationZh: 3D零件装配，指根据一组未组装的零件几何体预测其相对位姿并重构完整三维形状的任务。
特殊欧几里得群变换，指三维空间中的刚体旋转和平移变换。
一种基于BERT架构的点云特征编码模型，用于提取三维几何特征。
查询变换器，一种用于桥接视觉和语言特征的轻量级交叉注意力结构。
非自回归，指模型在单次前向推理中并行生成所有输出，而非逐个词或步骤生成。
